answer: One instrument should not underwrite many cheap keys. Bind every mining address to a single registered stilling-well tide gauge on a numbered jetty pile, leveled from a backshore dune benchmark and an inland summit monument. Shared well IDs drop both enrollments. A seed-tied water-level burst must be signed by that logger; the well's hydraulic residual will not transfer to a clone, so each new identity has to certify another well. Budgeting only: $3,500 to certify and $55 monthly telemetry; eighty extras cost about $280,000 and $4,400 that month.
